title: The employer match, for people without an employer.
subtitle: A sponsor funds a match. You deposit tokenized SPYx. The match is reserved for you on Solana and vests the longer you stay.
description: Leave early and you keep your deposit and whatever has vested. The rest goes back to the sponsor. Every number is on-chain.

panel.ariaLabel: An illustrative position: what you deposit, the sponsor's match, and how much has vested
panel.caption: Illustrative numbers, not a live pool.
